answer: Randomized Witness Rotation. Each epoch, a public verifiable random function draws a small witness set from all agents to countersign every new identity's first actions. An attacker cannot precompute which agents will audit a relic of registration metadata or predict which ledge of the queue gets sampled, so fake identities must flood every slot to survive. Detecting one unrevealed reef of collusion blocks the whole batch, forcing the attacker to pay full audit resources per identity.
